restaurants.name: Komal Molino
restaurants.notableFor: Variable hydration nixtamalization for blue, white, and red heirloom corn. Wholesales to Michelin-starred restaurants.

restaurants.name: La Yalaltequita
restaurants.notableFor: Third-generation Mecinas family preserving ancestral Oaxacan blandas tradition from Sierra Norte.

restaurants.name: Ditroit
restaurants.notableFor: Uses maíz criollo (chalqueño blanco). Treats corn varietals like wine treats grape varietals.

restaurants.name: Carnitas Uruapan
restaurants.notableFor: Metate-ground nixtamal using 1960s methodology.

restaurants.name: Los Cinco Puntos
restaurants.notableFor: Overnight alkaline bath rest; extra-thick traditional tortillas. Also serves buche, moronga, lamb head.

restaurants.name: Saby's Cafe
restaurants.notableFor: Small-batch hand-nixtamalized blue corn with walnut undertones.

restaurants.name: Tacos La Güera
restaurants.notableFor: Champions of the 'meat croissant' texture. Direct-shave from trompo to tortilla, no plancha.

restaurants.name: Leo's Taco Truck
restaurants.notableFor: Institutionalized the 'pineapple flick.' Bromelain enzymes serve functional purpose beyond spectacle.

restaurants.name: Taquería Frontera
restaurants.notableFor: Ranked #1 by multiple outlets. Paper-thin yellow tortillas from El Grano de Oro in Tijuana.

restaurants.name: Angel's Tijuana Tacos
restaurants.notableFor: Handmade tortillas with creamy guacamole integration.

restaurants.name: Tacos Tamix
restaurants.notableFor: Sliced-to-order with airborne pineapple technique.

restaurants.name: Sonoratown
restaurants.notableFor: Ambassador for Sonoran flour tortilla tradition. Beef short rib over mesquite. Drove 5 hours to the border for flour.

restaurants.name: Villa's Tacos
restaurants.notableFor: Michelin Bib Gourmand. Michoacán blue corn, mesquite-grilled, 'heavy build' with Monterey Jack, cotija, guacamole.

restaurants.name: Carnitas El Artista
restaurants.notableFor: Traditional copper cazo method. Four-generation recipe. Copper's thermal conductivity ensures uniform temperature.

restaurants.name: Carnitas Los Gabrieles
restaurants.notableFor: 800-pound capacity sidewalk cazo. 'Sticky' texture.

restaurants.name: Tacos Los Güichos
restaurants.notableFor: Mexico City street style. Trompa, oreja, buche.

restaurants.name: Metro Balderas
restaurants.notableFor: Snout-to-tail specialists. Traditional cazo. Offers nana (uterus), snout, ribs.

restaurants.name: Birrieria Familia Castro
restaurants.notableFor: Named #1 taco spot in America by Yelp 2025. Tijuana-style beef birria. Vampiros griddled until charred like bat wings.

restaurants.name: Goat Mafia
restaurants.notableFor: Traditionalist goat birria. 'Si no es chivo, no es birria.' Uses ginger, imperial stout in fall months.

restaurants.name: Barbacoa Ramirez
restaurants.notableFor: Raises his own lambs, butchers them himself. 24-hour underground pit wrapped in maguey. Ranch-to-pit-to-table.

restaurants.name: Holbox
restaurants.address: Mercado La Paloma, 3655 S Grand Ave
restaurants.notableFor: First Mexican marisquería in the U.S. to win a Michelin Star. Smoked kampachi taco. Uses Komal Molino's masa.

restaurants.name: Mariscos Jalisco
restaurants.notableFor: Perennial 'Best in Show' at Taco Madness. Taco dorado de camarón unchanged for decades.

restaurants.name: Mariscos El Chito
restaurants.notableFor: Yelp #10 nationally. Baja seafood and dorados.

restaurants.name: Evil Cooks
restaurants.notableFor: 'Death metal' taco innovators. Bracket contenders in Taco Madness.

restaurants.name: Tacos Los Cholos
restaurants.notableFor: #1 seed in 2026 Taco Madness. Charcoal grill masters.
